en-US.description: Softspoken, the private meeting notetaker and dictation app. Talk and it types. Meeting minutes with no bot, and your audio never leaves your computer.
en-US.longDescription:
Softspoken is the private meeting notetaker and dictation app for Windows, and it transcribes on your own computer. Hold a key in any app, say what you mean, and clean text lands at your cursor, about three times faster than typing. Take the minutes in a boardroom or on a Zoom or Teams call with no bot in the room, and get who said what, what was decided, and who owes what by when.

The audio never leaves your computer. Recording and transcription run on your own machine, and by default the audio is deleted once the notes are written. The optional AI layer, for cleaning up dictation, writing meeting summaries and preparing for the next meeting, runs in Australia by default, or on your own Anthropic or AWS key on a paid plan, or you can turn AI off entirely.

- Dictation in any app: speak instead of typing, anywhere on your PC.
- Meetings without a bot: in person or on Teams and Zoom, nothing joins the call.
- Private by design: on-device transcription, and your audio is never uploaded.
- Walk in prepared: Upcoming lists your week from your calendar, each meeting shows what came before, and Help me prepare suggests talking points and open items to raise.
- Actions that go where you work: send them to Todoist, then tick them off in either app.
- Organised by client and by person: a folder for each client, a page for each person, and actions with an owner and a due date.
- Keep a client off AI: one switch on a folder, and its meetings are never sent to any AI model.
- Import what you already have: recordings are transcribed on your computer, and Teams or Zoom transcripts come in as they are.
- Your meetings work for you: ask questions across everything you have recorded, and connect your library to Claude and other AI tools.

The app is free. Optional Softspoken AI and Pro features are available separately.
